Names in this guide: `subagent` is `Agent`, `skill` is `Skill`, and `mcp__papermemory__*` is `mcp__plugin_academic-harness_papermemory__*`. If a tool named below is not in your tool list, say so.

## Systematic reviews

`review` is a stateful ledger for systematic or scoping reviews and PRISMA-style audits — not for ordinary literature surveys. Use it only when the user asks for a systematic/scoping review or a screening funnel that must be reproducible. Start with `review` `start` (question, databases, inclusion/exclusion criteria, date range) before searching. Discovery stays in the search layer: run `literature_search` or the source-specific tools, then `review add` each query's results (the result array or a workspace JSON/JSONL file); deduplication by DOI/PMID/arXiv/title+year is automatic.

Every screening decision and reason must come from the user or the stated criteria — never infer, batch, or invent one. Declare reviewer identities as `human:<name>` or `ai:<model>` at `start` (optional `reviewers` list); with two or more, each reviewer screens independently, `status` shows per-reviewer counts and conflicts, and `reconcile` records a consensus or third-reviewer decision while both originals stay in the log. `screen` enforces the funnel per reviewer: `full_text` needs that reviewer's `title_abstract` include, an exclude/maybe needs a non-empty reason, and re-screening needs `override: true` and only replaces that reviewer's own event. Add `evidence` only after a resolved full-text include (not one in conflict), quoting verbatim with a location (page/section); the ledger records the quote but does not verify it — PaperMemory `quote_check`/`trace` remains the verifier. Run `status` before reporting counts, and investigate `included_without_evidence` and unresolved conflicts rather than presenting a clean PRISMA table. Produce the deliverable with `export` (markdown report skeleton + PRISMA counts, evidence CSV, JSON, or the risk-of-bias `rob-table`/`rob-summary`/`rob-figure` outputs); exports refuse to overwrite unless `overwrite: true`. Load the `systematic-review-ledger` skill for the full workflow.

For risk of bias, freeze an instrument at `start` (`instruments: ["rob-2"]`) or on first `appraise`, then record one domain judgement per reviewer with `appraise`. Bundled instruments: `rob-2` and `robins-i` (interventions), `quadas-2` (diagnostic accuracy, risk-of-bias and applicability cells), `nos` (cohort/case-control star counts), `amstar-2` (systematic reviews), `probast` (prediction models, with applicability cells), `quips` (prognostic factors), `syrcle` (animal studies), and the `casp-cohort`/`casp-case-control`/`casp-qualitative` checklists (yes / can't tell / no). `low`/`high` (ROBINS-I `low`/`critical`; checklist `yes`/`no`) need a verbatim quote and location; with a PaperMemory `paper` the quote is re-found through `papermemory_quote_check` and a quote that does not appear is rejected, otherwise it is stored `unverified`. Signalling answers are supporting detail and are never converted into a judgement. RoB 2 and ROBINS-I derive the overall from the domains (marked derived); an explicit `domain: "overall"` override needs a reason. `reconcile` resolves appraisal disagreements the same way as screening, and `appraisal_status` reports completeness. `agreement` reports percent agreement and Cohen's kappa (linear/quadratic weighted for ordinal scales, pairwise above two raters); human kappa never includes AI, which is reported separately. Exports are recorded judgements and verified evidence, never "low risk", a quality score, or a submission guarantee. Load the `risk-of-bias-appraisal` skill.

### Structured extraction

Freeze an extraction template at `start` (`extraction_template: "pico"`, `peco`, `diagnostic_accuracy`, `prognostic`, `qualitative`, `generic`, or an inline field list) or on the first `extract`; the template is write-once. `extract` records one named reviewer's values for one included record, with optional field-level `quotes`; use `row_id` for multiple outcomes, arms, or comparisons instead of overwriting. `extract_status` reports completeness, required-field gaps, field conflicts, and quote verification. A field disagreement is resolved only by `reconcile scope=extraction field=… value=… reviewer=… reason=…`, which keeps both originals. Values are recorded, never inferred; a missing required field is counted, not filled. Export with `extraction-table`/`extraction-matrix` (Markdown/CSV) or `extraction-json`; `export format=prisma-flow` writes a PRISMA-style SVG plus a counts JSON sidecar, labelled PRISMA-style and never a compliance verdict.
